Apply to 6,702 Python Developer Jobs

Python developer jobs focus on building software applications, automation tools, and data-driven systems using one of the most widely adopted programming languages in the world. Python powers everything from web platforms and financial tools to artificial intelligence and machine learning systems. Freshers often begin with scripting, debugging, and automation tasks, while experienced developers design scalable back-end architectures and high-performance applications. With strong demand across industries and growing remote opportunities, Python development offers long-term career stability and rapid growth.

Scope of Python Developer Jobs


The scope of Python developer jobs continues to expand as businesses rely more on data, automation, and cloud-based applications. E-commerce companies use Python frameworks like Django and Flask to manage product catalogs, user authentication, and order processing. Fintech firms apply Python for transaction analysis, risk detection, and real-time reporting. Data teams rely on Python libraries to process large datasets and generate business insights.


Major hiring demand comes from technology hubs such as Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, and Gurgaon. Large IT firms and product startups regularly hire Python talent for backend development, API integration, data analytics, and automation projects. Many roles also support flexible or remote work models.

Requirements for Python Developer Jobs


Most employers expect candidates to demonstrate proficiency in the following areas:


  1. 1. Python Fundamentals: Core language knowledge, control flow, functions, and OOP.
  2. 2. Frameworks: Hands-on experience with Django, Flask, or FastAPI for web and API development.
  3. 3. Databases: Knowledge of MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB for backend storage and queries.
  4. 4. Data Libraries: Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib (especially for analytics roles).
  5. 5. Tools & Practices: Git version control, debugging, basic DevOps, containerization (Docker), and cloud basics (AWS, GCP, Azure).

While a degree in Computer Science or IT is preferred, candidates with strong project portfolios or GitHub contributions are often prioritized—especially for fresher and mid-level roles.

Average Python Developer Salaries in India


  • 1. Freshers: ₹5 – ₹8 lakh per year
  • 2. Mid-level Developers (2–4 years): ₹10 – ₹15 lakh per year
  • 3. Senior Developers / Architects: ₹20 – ₹30 lakh+ per year

Python professionals in product-based companies or full-time remote roles often receive higher compensation, performance bonuses, ESOPs, and flexible work benefits.

Common questions from candidates searching this role

Python is also known as an interpreted language. A python developer is liable for writing server-side web applications logic. They are also responsible for developing back end components, connect the applications with the other web services and support the front end developers by integrating their work with python applications. It is one of the most widely used programming language by the developers.

Python is a popular language and used by many web developers. It is a language which can run on different platforms like Windows, Mac, Linux etc. A candidate who wants to become a python developer need to have the required skills; he/she should be able to integrate multiple data sources and database into one system, understanding of the threading limitations of Python, basic knowledge of front end technologies such as Javascript, HTML5 and CSS3, understanding of fundamental design principles behind a scalable applications and many other.

Python developers are responsible for managing the interchange of data between the server and the users. A python developer having an experience of 1 to 2 years can earn from INR 3 to 5 Lakh per annum. In addition, candidates having an experience of 3 to 5 years can earn from INR 7 to 9 Lakh per annum. Moreover, If the candidate is having a professional experience of 5 to 9 years, he/she can earn from 10 to 12 Lakh per annum or more.
